0.text: XXIII. — CONTACT OF THE CHUKCHEE WITH THE RUSSIANS.¹

1.text: DISCOVERY. — The first information concerning the Chukchee was brought

2.text: by the Cossack Michael Stadukhin, who, in 1644, went to the Kolyma River

3.text: and founded the winter hamlet (зимовье) of Nishne-Kolymsk.

4.text: ¹ The historical sketch contained in this chapter is based on data collected by the author in the Archives

5.text: of Sredne-Kolymsk, Nishne-Kolymsk, Markova on the Anadyr, also extracted from old documents of the same

6.text: provenience, which are in the possession of the author. Besides the sources enumerated in the list of author-

7.text: ities (p. 3), several other works and editions of documents have been used. Almost all of them are Russian,

8.text: and their titles are given with English translation.

9.text: 1. Историческіе Акты, собранные и издаииые Археографической Коммисіей, III, IV, V.
9.note: издаииые is the print, keyed verbatim per §2.14 ('gt/ocr never repairs the book'). Confirmed a genuine misprint rather than a misreading: the published title is Акты историческіе, собранные и изданные Археографическою коммиссіею (SPb 1841–42), so изданные is correct and the compositor set ии for нн. The ии are cleanly formed — contrasted at 4× against the нн of собранные in the same strip — so this is branch 1 (a set wrong letter), not wear. Identification #llm. Bogoras also cites loosely here: he prints Историческіе Акты and Коммисіей where the work sets Акты историческіе and коммиссіею; that belongs in authorities.json, not in the transcript.

20.text: 6. Дополненія къ Твореніямъ Святыхъ Отцовъ, Части 9, 11. (Москва, 1850—52).
20.note: Numerals read as Roman II by the reader; corrected to Arabic 11. Bogoras's facing English (line 21) sets the same pair, and its form matches the 1 opening 1850 in the same strip. Independently: the series (Прибавленія къ изданію твореній святыхъ отцовъ, Moscow 1843–1891) ran Part 8 = 1849 and Part 12 = 1853, so Parts 9 and 11 are 1850 and 1852 — exactly the printed range (Москва, 1850—52). Roman II = 2 contradicts it. Correction proposed by a model, #llm, awaiting ratification.

21.text: Supplements to the Works of the Holy Fathers, Parts 9, 11 (Moscow, 1850—52).
21.note: Same correction as line 20, the facing English of the same entry: Roman II → Arabic 11. #llm, awaiting ratification.

30.text: 11. Собраніе сочиненій изъ мѣсяцеслововъ различныхъ лѣтъ, С-Петербургъ, 1790.
30.note: мѣсяцеслововъ: the letter between с and ц prints н-shaped and no я bowl is visible at 4×, the ceiling. Read as a damaged sort per §2.14 branch 2 ('wear is not a letter') rather than as a set н, so the text stands and the class is artifact. Corroborated externally: the work is Собраніе сочиненій, выбранныхъ изъ мѣсяцослововъ на разные годы (SPb 1790), where месяцесловов is the genitive plural of месяцесловъ — so я is the letter the compositor set. Bogoras abridges the title; that difference belongs in authorities.json. Identification #llm.
